statement: Annotated blind from the Beinecke scan only (canvas 1006209, '75v'). Upper drawing: a patterned tube descends from the top margin into a long blue scalloped vessel with two radiating bursts; ten two-line label tags hang from the vessel, each on a thin line that ends on the head of one of ten bare-breasted female figures standing in a long green trough (left four face right, the fifth faces the viewer, the right five face left). Lower drawing: a blue pool of two joined basins holding about 19 nude female figures, fed by a blue tube down the left margin and drained by a blue tube to the bottom edge. Label assignment: the label line ids f75v.18-.37 come in ten @/+ pairs, and there are ten tags; I assign tag i (counted left to right on the scan) to lines f75v.(16+2i) and .(17+2i), giving the first line id as 'label'. This assumes the transcription numbers the tags left to right; I did not read any words to check it. The seven short labels around the pool (f75v.50-.56 by line structure: three on one level, then four stacked) do not point at single figures and are left unassigned. Lines f75v.2-.11 marked as labels sit level with the top paragraph lines and are not tied to any drawn object here.
